credits.title: Feisbum - Il film
credits.overview: The title translates literally as "Faceboom." An omnibus film helmed by seven top-tiered Italian directors, this comedy explores the worldwide Facebook craze of the early 21st century by recounting the adventures of numerous Europeans whose lives are altered by that social networking site.

credits.title: Radio West
credits.overview: Three Italian soldiers volunteer to go to Kosovo after the war, where they risk their lives to help a young girl.
